blocks.text: Ezekiel 47 forms part of the wider vision in chapters 40–48, which includes a measured sanctuary, its worshiping community, land, tribes, a river, and a city. This chapter moves from water flowing from the sanctuary and bringing life to the land’s boundaries and the inheritance assigned among Israel’s tribes and resident aliens. Read as part of that larger visionary whole, these scenes belong together rather than standing as unrelated topics.
